title: Luhn Check Validator
h1: Luhn Check Validator — Card Number Checksum
seoTitle: Luhn Check Validator — Card Number Checksum
description: Check a card or ID number with the Luhn checksum in your browser. Digits never leave the page, and the result shows the check digit and brand hint.
intro: Paste a number to test the Luhn checksum used by payment cards and some ID schemes. Spaces and dashes are ignored. Nothing is uploaded.
blurb: Validate a card or ID number with the Luhn checksum, locally in the browser.
howItWorks: Spaces and dashes are stripped so only digits remain.
The Luhn algorithm doubles every second digit from the right and sums the digits.
A total divisible by 10 is valid. A brand hint is inferred from the prefix only.
examples: 4242424242424242 is a common Visa-format test number and passes Luhn.
4242424242424241 fails because the check digit is wrong.
Dashes in 3782-822463-10005 are ignored before the checksum.

faq.q: Does a passing check mean the card is real?
faq.a: No. Luhn only checks the checksum. It cannot confirm that an account exists, is funded, or is not stolen.

faq.q: Is the number sent to a server?
faq.a: No. The check runs in your browser and the field is not submitted anywhere.
